note: EMPTY ON PURPOSE. Ron and Friends 2026 is a REDRAFT: there is no prior season for this league — the Sleeper league has no `previous_league_id` and every roster came back empty — so there is nothing to resolve a keeper clock against and nobody to keep.
whyTheFileStillExists: The keeper machinery is kept on disk so the league can switch keepers on in a later season without rebuilding it. This file is one of the overlay's inputs; empty is how the data says 'no keepers', which is the layer the board actually reads.
